types.name: Word and common Office shortcuts
types.description: Asks which key combination does a job (or what a combination does) in Word or in all Office programs, such as bold, hyperlink, close, undo or alignment.

types.name: Word features and menus
types.description: Asks what a Word feature does or where it is found: print settings, shading, borders, mail merge, track changes, headers, page layout, tables of contents.

types.name: Excel formulas and functions
types.description: Names an Excel function (SUM, COUNTA, IF, VLOOKUP, MATCH, ROUND) or a formula and asks what it returns, which category it belongs to, or how it works.

types.name: Excel cells and references
types.description: Asks about cell addresses, ranges, relative, absolute or mixed references, or what a formula becomes when it is copied.

types.name: Excel data, charts and sheet limits
types.description: Asks about charts, sorting, filtering, inserting rows or columns, worksheet limits (rows, columns, characters) or data tools.

types.name: Excel keyboard shortcuts
types.description: Asks which key or combination does a job inside Excel, such as editing a cell, inserting the date, AutoSum or a new sheet.

types.name: PowerPoint slides, views and keys
types.description: Asks about PowerPoint: slide-show keys, views, templates, slide master, transitions, animations or adding and deleting slides.

types.name: Office screen and file types
types.description: Asks about parts of the Office window (ribbon, tabs, Quick Access Toolbar, status bar, Name Box) or file extensions and default settings.
